decisions.reason: The garage door operator line builds directly on the firm's core door and drive know-how and complements its garage door range, so the firm can interpret market feedback and keep refining it, though the missing website evidence for 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.

The insulated glazed industrial door draws on the firm's established thermal and industrial door expertise and meets demand driven by energy regulation, and it survived the 2019 clean-up of overlapping glazed variants, although the lack of recent website visibility slightly raises the withdrawal risk.
